domains.label: Customers
domains.description: Stores customer identity details and their postal and billing contact addresses.

domains.label: Policies
domains.description: Stores insurance policies and the agreements and coverage items that define them.

domains.label: Quotes
domains.description: Manages insurance quote requests, quote offers, and their lifecycle status history.

elements.name: public.addresses
elements.role: Stores a customer's street address, city, and postal code.

elements.name: public.customerinfos
elements.role: Stores customer identity details and links the customer to contact and billing addresses.

elements.name: public.insuranceagreementitems
elements.role: Stores titled descriptive items that form part of an insurance agreement.

elements.name: public.insuranceoptions
elements.role: Stores named insurance options, including their starting date and deductible.

elements.name: public.insurancepolicies
elements.role: Stores issued policy details, dates, customer, premiums, limits, deductibles, and associated insuring agreement.

elements.name: public.insurancequoterequests
elements.role: Stores a customer's dated quote request and its linked options, quote, and policy reference.

elements.name: public.insurancequoterequests_status_history
elements.role: Associates a quote request with its status-change history records.

elements.name: public.insurancequotes
elements.role: Stores offered premium and policy limit amounts and quote expiration.

elements.name: public.insuringagreements
elements.role: Represents an insuring agreement associated with an insurance policy.

elements.name: public.insuringagreements_agreement_items
elements.role: Links insuring agreements to the insurance agreement items they include.

elements.name: public.requeststatuschanges
elements.role: Records dated quote-request lifecycle status changes, limited to the defined request and quote states.
